status_summary: No CMS or tri-agency action since 2025-01-20 was found that addresses shared savings or reference pricing plan designs for consumers. The Transparency in Coverage final rule published 2026-10-06 (effective 2026-12-07) expands price disclosure by group health plans and insurers, but it does not establish or clarify shared savings or reference pricing designs.
title: Ensure shared savings and reference pricing plan designs are permitted
uncertainties: Mandate text on page 469 was checked. The Transparency in Coverage final rule was read only in part (the page was truncated). The Federal Register API was queried for reference pricing since 2025-01-20 and returned only the transparency rule, hospital price and international drug pricing model rules, which are different subjects. Shared savings designs were already addressed in earlier-period transparency rules, which are not counted here. No WebSearch was run for this item; absence of evidence rests on the Federal Register listing only. Related record c14-13 covers HSA and direct primary care; c14-21 covers hospital price transparency.
